title: एकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 61 · The four stages of life

summary.en: Bhishma describes the stages of life: the student, the householder, the forest-dweller and the renouncer. He tells the rules of each and says that the householder's life, in which all are supported, is the root of the others.
summary.kn: ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಹಂತಗಳನ್ನು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚಾರಿ, ಗೃಹಸ್ಥ, ವಾನಪ್ರಸ್ಥ, ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತದ ನಿಯಮ ಹೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಧಾರವಾದ ಗೃಹಸ್ಥ ಜೀವನ ಇತರ ಹಂತಗಳ ಮೂಲವೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीष्म जीवन के आश्रम बताते हैं: ब्रह्मचारी, गृहस्थ, वानप्रस्थ और संन्यासी। वे प्रत्येक के नियम बताते हैं और कहते हैं कि गृहस्थ जीवन, जिसमें सब पोषित होते हैं, अन्य सबका मूल है।
summary.te: భీష్ముడు జీవిత దశలను వర్ణిస్తాడు: బ్రహ్మచారి, గృహస్థు, వానప్రస్థుడు, సన్యాసి. ప్రతి దశ నియమాలను చెప్పి అందరికీ ఆధారమైన గృహస్థ జీవితం ఇతరాలకు మూలమంటాడు.
summary.ta: பீஷ்மர் வாழ்வின் நிலைகளை விவரிக்கிறார்: மாணவன், இல்லறத்தான், வனவாசி, துறவி. ஒவ்வொன்றின் விதிகளைக் கூறி, எல்லோரையும் தாங்கும் இல்லற வாழ்வே மற்றவற்றின் வேர் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ഭീഷ്മർ ജീവിതഘട്ടങ്ങൾ വിവരിക്കുന്നു: ബ്രഹ്മചാരി, ഗൃഹസ്ഥൻ, വാനപ്രസ്ഥൻ, സന്ന്യാസി. ഓരോന്നിന്റെയും നിയമങ്ങൾ പറയുന്ന അദ്ദേഹം, എല്ലാവരെയും പോറ്റുന്ന ഗൃഹസ്ഥജീവിതമാണ് മറ്റുള്ളവയുടെ അടിസ്ഥാനമെന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.61; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
आश्रमाणां महाबाहो शृणु सत्यपराक्रम ।
चतुर्णामिह वर्णानां कर्माणि च युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Listen, mighty-armed Yudhishthira of true valor, to the duties of the stages of life and the works of the four classes.

verses.text:
वानप्रस्थं भैक्षचर्यां गार्हस्थ्यं च महाश्रमम् ।
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमं प्राहुश्चतुर्थं ब्राह्मणैर्वृतम् ॥

meaning.en: They speak of the forest-dweller, the wandering beggar, the householder, the great stage, and the student, the fourth, chosen by brahmins.

verses.text:
जटाकरणसंस्कारं द्विजातित्वमवाप्य च ।
आधानादीनि कर्माणि प्राप्य वेदमधीत्य च ॥

meaning.en: Having received the rite of the matted hair and attained twice-born status, having performed the rites beginning with the setting of the fire and studied the Veda,

verses.text:
सदारो वाप्यदारो वा आत्मवान्संयतेन्द्रियः ।
वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गच्छेत्कृतकृत्यो गृहाश्रमात् ॥

meaning.en: with a wife or without, self-possessed and with senses restrained, having done his duty as householder he should go to the forest stage.

verses.text:
तत्रारण्यकशास्त्राणि समधीत्य स धर्मवित् ।
ऊर्ध्वरेताः प्रजायित्वा गच्छत्यक्षरसात्मताम् ॥

meaning.en: There the knower of dharma studies the forest scriptures, practises chastity, begets children, and attains oneness with the imperishable.

verses.text:
एतान्येव निमित्तानि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ।
कर्तव्यानीह विप्रेण राजन्नादौ विपश्चिता ॥

meaning.en: These same observances, king, are to be done here by a wise brahmin at the outset, for sages who practise chastity.

verses.text:
चरितब्रह्मचर्यस्य ब्राह्मणस्य विशां पते ।
भैक्षचर्यास्वधीकारः प्रशस्त इह मोक्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: For a brahmin who has practised studentship, lord of the people, the mendicant's wandering is praised here for one seeking liberation.

verses.text:
यत्रास्तमितशायी स्यान्निरग्निरनिकेतनः ।
यथोपलब्धजीवी स्यान्मुनिर्दान्तो जितेन्द्रियः ॥

meaning.en: There he should sleep wherever he is at sunset, without fire and without a home, living on whatever he gets, a sage, self-controlled, master of his senses.

verses.text:
निराशीः स्यात्सर्वसमो निर्भोगो निर्विकारवान् ।
विप्रः क्षेमाश्रमं प्राप्तो गच्छत्यक्षरसात्मताम् ॥

meaning.en: Free from hope, equal to all, without enjoyments or change, a brahmin who has reached the stage of safety attains oneness with the imperishable.

verses.text:
अधीत्य वेदान्कृतसर्वकृत्यः
संतानमुत्पाद्य सुखानि भुक्त्वा ।
समाहितः प्रचरेद्दुश्चरं तं
गार्हस्थ्यधर्मं मुनिधर्मदृष्टम् ॥

meaning.en: Having studied the Vedas and done all his duties, having begotten offspring and enjoyed pleasures, let him, composed, practise the hard dharma of the householder as the sages see it.

verses.text:
स्वदारतुष्ट ऋतुकालगामी
नियोगसेवी नशठो नजिह्मः ।
मिताशनो देवपरः कृतज्ञः
सत्यो मृदुश्चानृशंसः क्षमावान् ॥

meaning.en: Content with his own wife, approaching her in her season, doing his service, not deceitful or crooked, moderate in food, devoted to the gods, grateful, truthful, gentle, kind and forgiving,

verses.text:
दान्तो विधेयो हव्यकव्येऽप्रमत्तो
अन्नस्य दाता सततं द्विजेभ्यः ।
अमत्सरी सर्वलिङ्गिप्रदाता
वैताननित्यश्च गृहाश्रमी स्यात् ॥

meaning.en: self-controlled, obedient, careful in offerings to gods and ancestors, always giving food to brahmins, free of malice, a giver of all the signs of renunciation, constant in the fire-rites: such should the householder be.

verses.text:
अथात्र नारायणगीतमाहु-
र्महर्षयस्तात महानुभावाः ।
महार्थमत्यर्थतपःप्रयुक्तं
तदुच्यमानं हि मया निबोध ॥

meaning.en: Here the great-minded sages have recited a verse sung by Narayana, dear child, of great meaning and joined with great austerity; hear it as I tell it.

verses.text:
सत्यार्जवं चातिथिपूजनं च
धर्मस्तथार्थश्च रतिश्च दारे ।
निषेवितव्यानि सुखानि लोके
ह्यस्मिन्परे चैव मतं ममैतत् ॥

meaning.en: Truth and uprightness, honoring guests, dharma and wealth, and delight in one's wife: these pleasures are to be enjoyed in the world, here and hereafter, in my view.

verses.text:
भरणं पुत्रदाराणां वेदानां पारणं तथा ।
सतां तमाश्रमं श्रेष्ठं वदन्ति परमर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: Supporting sons and wives and reciting the Vedas to the end: the great sages call that the best stage of the good.

verses.text:
एवं हि यो ब्राह्मणो यज्ञशीलो
गार्हस्थ्यमध्यावसते यथावत् ।
गृहस्थवृत्तिं प्रविशोध्य सम्य-
क्स्वर्गे विशुद्धं फलमाप्नुते सः ॥

meaning.en: So the brahmin who loves sacrifice and lives the householder's life properly, purifying his householder's livelihood fully, wins a pure reward in heaven.

verses.text:
तस्य देहपरित्यागादिष्टाः कामाक्षया मताः ।
आनन्त्यायोपतिष्ठन्ति सर्वतोक्षिशिरोमुखाः ॥

meaning.en: After his body is cast off, the desires he wished for are held to be fulfilled for him, and they stand before him without end, with eyes, heads and faces on every side.

verses.text:
खादन्नेको जपन्नेकः सर्पन्नेको युधिष्ठिर ।
एकस्मिन्नेव आचार्ये शुश्रूषुर्मलपङ्कवान् ॥

meaning.en: Eating alone, reciting alone, moving alone, Yudhishthira, a student wishing to serve one teacher alone, stained with dust and mud,

verses.text:
ब्रह्मचारी व्रती नित्यं नित्यं दीक्षापरो वशी ।
अविचार्य तथा वेदं कृत्यं कुर्वन्वसेत्सदा ॥

meaning.en: a student always keeping his vows, always intent on consecration and self-controlled, should live doing the task without questioning the Veda.

verses.text:
शुश्रूषां सततं कुर्वन्गुरोः संप्रणमेत च ।
षट्कर्मस्वनिवृत्तश्च नप्रवृत्तश्च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Always serving his teacher and bowing to him, never turning from the six duties yet not wholly engaged in them,

verses.text:
न चरत्यधिकारेण सेवितं द्विषतो न च ।
एषोऽऽश्रमपदस्तात ब्रह्मचारिण इष्यते ॥

meaning.en: he should not walk about with presumption, nor serve one who hates his teacher. This, dear child, is held to be the stage of the student.
